State 01: Origins

Founding Story

College of Engineering Trivandrum established in 1939, marking the beginning of a legacy of technical excellence in Kerala. From a modest beginning to becoming a NIRF Top 100 institution, CET's journey spans over eight decades of engineering education.

  • 1939: CET founded
  • First building constructed
  • NAAC A+ accreditation
  • NIRF Top 100 ranking

State 03: Festivals

CET's Three Festivals

CET's cultural calendar is highlighted by three distinctive festivals: Drishti (technical), Dhwani (cultural), and Disha (leadership). Each festival showcases student talent, creativity, and community spirit across the campus.
